name: USAspending API
description: Every federal contract, grant, loan and direct payment - who received it, from which agency, for what, and where the recipient is - covering more than $10 trillion of awards since 2008. Search is a POST API with a rich filter object; agency and reference lookups are plain GETs.

access.size_hint: the bulk award archives run to tens of GB per fiscal year
access.rate_limit: none published; the search endpoint is heavy, so page rather than widen
access.pagination: page and limit inside the POST body; limit max 100 for search

probes.note: Reachable, but this endpoint's TLS chain was rejected by Python's OpenSSL 3.5 on the machine that ran the probes on 2026-09-06 ('self-signed certificate in certificate chain') while curl against the same host, on the same bundle, returned 200. A grey dot here is a fact about the prober, not about USAspending.

recipes.title: Largest contracts in a quarter
recipes.code:
curl -s -X POST https://api.usaspending.gov/api/v2/search/spending_by_award/ \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"filters":{"award_type_codes":["A","B","C","D"],"time_period":[{"start_date":"2024-01-01","end_date":"2024-03-31"}]},"fields":["Award ID","Recipient Name","Award Amount","Awarding Agency"],"sort":"Award Amount","order":"desc","limit":10}' | python3 -m json.tool | head -40

gotchas.trap: The fields list uses human-readable labels with spaces and exact capitalisation ('Award ID', not award_id). A wrong label is a 400 with a long validation message.
gotchas.fix: Read the endpoint's docs page for the exact label list; they differ per award type.

gotchas.trap: award_type_codes is required on the award search and there is no 'everything' value.
gotchas.fix: A, B, C, D are contracts; 02-05 grants; 07, 08 loans; 06, 10 direct payments.
